contemporary_sanskrit_transcription.claim: Later Sanskrit transcription presents dream couplets as combined verses and relabels the chapter 38
contemporary_sanskrit_transcription.critical_metadata_problem: Page header incorrectly describes Raja Yoga Obstructions, while verse text clearly discusses five-elements/natures; do not take auto-generated summary as authoritative.

translation_discrepancies.concept: pitta dream imagery: grotesque human category vs botanic cluster
translation_discrepancies.uploaded_english_exact: red lotus, eunuch, blood and lightning
translation_discrepancies.source_print: Saravali Ch37 verse25, JainQQ scan p175
translation_discrepancies.modern_sanskrit_translation: groups of red lotuses, floods of blood, and masses of lightning
translation_discrepancies.interpretation: Compound 'rakta-abja-ṣaṇḍa' denotes a grove/cluster of red lotuses in context; English 'eunuch' appears to arise from interpreting ṣaṇḍa out of compound.
translation_discrepancies.remedy: Preserve uploaded literal text but exclude 'eunuch dream' indicator from any proposed model until independently confirmed Sanskrit critical edition.

translation_discrepancies.concept: kapha dream imagery: coral versus pearls
translation_discrepancies.source_print: Saravali Ch37 verse27, JainQQ scan p175
translation_discrepancies.interpretation: Muktāphala means pearls; no coral term in this span. The supplied English edition's coral motif is materially different.
translation_discrepancies.remedy: Do not silently replace historic uploaded wording; if modelized use source-qualified separately frozen variants pending collation.

translation_discrepancies.uploaded_english_exact: Chapter 38 Effects of natural constituents and primordial compounds
translation_discrepancies.source_print: Sanskrit print Chapter 37 includes Panchamahapurusha material and element/dream verses, with 22,23/24,25/26,27 numbering
translation_discrepancies.modern_sanskrit_translation: online Sanskrit webpage labels Ch38 and collapses consecutive verse pairs into one displayed item
translation_discrepancies.remedy: Use explicit per-edition verse crosswalk, not blind assumption that numbered references agree.

edition_cautions: Online Sanskrit transcription has contradictory site-specific chapter title and combines paired slokas; not an independent manuscript.
Catalog describes a 1928 edition but digitized composite includes later 2012 front matter; source edition and later compilation should be catalogued separately.
The two web Sanskrit transcriptions agree on relevant phrases but may share ancestor; not two independent textual witnesses.
Structural difference arises from verse rearrangement, not merely shifting the chapter number.

independent_classical_motif_parallels.source: Preethishree M. and Pratibha Kulkarni, Swapna in Ayurveda, Journal of Ayurveda and Integrated Medical Sciences 2022 7(3):47–52
independent_classical_motif_parallels.findings: Classical Ayurvedic sources summarized: vata→wandering/flying, pitta→sun/gold/bright light/fire/lightning, kapha→ponds/lotuses/swans.

independent_classical_motif_parallels.source: Tendulkar SS, Dwivedi RR, Swapna in the Indian classics: Mythology or science? AYU 2010;31(2):170–174
independent_classical_motif_parallels.findings: Classical Indian/Ayurvedic literatures link dream content to dominant doshic temperament; review explicitly discusses substantial mythology and uncertainty.

inference: Saravali's dream mapping has a close non-astrological Ayurvedic explanatory counterpart; it cannot be counted as uniquely generated by natal astrology. Shared formulas/motifs may reflect common cultural scholarship but borrowing direction/chronology is not established.
future_comparison_design: When considered for an actual test, freeze the astrology planet-strength-to-temperament mapping and dream motifs, collect prospective dream journals, compare with an Ayurveda-only classifier and empirical population dream-motif baseline. Never score variants post hoc. Treat Ayurveda temperaments as historical constructs, not established objective biomedical phenotypes.
